Title: Source 2: King John
Content: This drawing shows King John of Enland, who ruled rom `text(1199)` to `text(1216)`. It was made in the `text(1500s)`, as part of a book with biographies and pictures of key people in Europe. In this picture, King John is shown wearing a crown and armor. He is holding a sword in `text(one)` hand. In his other hand is an object known as globus cruciger (orb and cross). It was a common symbol of authority during his time. King John's coat of arms with `text(three)` lions is shown in the upper left corner.
